events.title: Introduction to Glaze Making With Marc Savage
events.location: Pottery Studio, Sunshine Coast Art Group (SCArt)
events.description: This is the final session of an introductory pottery workshop focused on glaze making techniques, run by the Sunshine Coast Art Group. Participants will learn practical skills for creating and applying glazes in a community pottery studio setting.

events.title: Advanced Wheel Throwing with Marc Sauvage
events.location: SCArt Pottery Studio, Sunshine Coast Art Group
events.description: This is the final session of an advanced pottery workshop focused on wheel throwing techniques, hosted by the Sunshine Coast Art Group. Participants will refine their skills in shaping clay on the potter's wheel in a creative community environment.

events.title: How Soon is Now? (Art Exhibition by Bruce Reynolds)
events.description: An art exhibition by Bruce Reynolds, exploring contemporary themes through visual art, on display at the Caloundra Regional Gallery until June 28. It offers an opportunity to experience local artistic talent and engage with new perspectives.

events.title: Outspoken presents: a conversation with Kate Holden
events.description: An evening conversation with author Kate Holden, presented by Outspoken, likely discussing her work, insights into culture, or human experience. This event provides an opportunity for intellectual engagement and potentially Q&A with the author.

events.title: Winter Wunderland Street Party
events.description: A free community street party in Caloundra, offering a festive "Winter Wunderland" atmosphere for all ages. Expect local entertainment, food, and social interaction in a vibrant outdoor setting.

events.title: BTW Book Club - The Deal by Elle Kennedy
events.description: The BTW Book Club meets to discuss "The Deal" by Elle Kennedy, offering a chance to engage in literary discussion and connect with other readers. It's a community-focused event for sharing perspectives on the chosen book.

events.title: ON THE WILD SIDE: Filming Creatures Great and Small Presented by Pieter de Vries
events.location: Lecture Theatre 1, K Block, UniSC Sippy Downs
events.description: Pieter de Vries presents a public lecture on his experiences filming wildlife, offering insights into nature photography, documentary filmmaking, and the natural world. This event is for those interested in science, nature, and creative storytelling.
